I checked our allergen list: the mapo tofu has no tree nut listed, though it's prepared in a shared kitchen, so cross-contact is possible.
Sure. What's the full delivery address?
You're inside our delivery zone. That's mapo tofu and kung pao chicken and dan dan noodles, $54.00 with the delivery fee. We'll text you when the driver leaves.
Can I get a name and phone number for the order?
